title: Morning Brief data
description: The only thing the model writes. scripts/render_brief.py turns it into the standalone HTML page. All strings are plain text; the renderer escapes them.

date.description: Today in the home timezone; used for the output file name.

lang.description: BCP 47 language of every visible sentence, e.g. "ko" or "en". RTL languages mirror the page.

date_line.description: Small line above the headline, e.g. "월요일 · 2026년 10월 5일".

headline.description: One serif sentence. Required unless page_message is used.

day_class.description: Optional. The renderer recomputes it from events and warns on a mismatch.

page_message.description: Only when nothing at all is connected: two friendly sentences that replace the whole page.

acts.description: Three time windows under the drawing, each one third of the terrain width.

sentence.description: One observation earned from the calendar.

events.description: Today's calendar events only. No titles: the drawing shows shape, not names.

optional.description: Optional or unanswered: grey and weightless.

overlap.description: Part of a genuine double booking: drawn as a hollow circle.

motifs.description: At most one per act. Clay on at most one motif in the whole drawing.

kind.description: sun = open creative time; half_sun = start before 7:30; moon = late finish; birds = room to breathe; fireworks = holiday eve; flag = deadline; ridge = depth on a HEAVY day (no act).

empty_line.description: Override for the calm line shown when both lists are empty.

connect_hint.description: One line inviting an inbox or chat connection when only the calendar is connected.

buttons_enabled.description: true only when the invocation contains the exact phrase "Include action buttons".

topics_covered.description: Not rendered. What today's brief actually covered, for the optional topic log.

sections.description: Enabled optional sections, in profile order, rendered below Resolved. A section with nothing found is left out.

phrase.description: Exact substring of the text that becomes the link.

title.description: ≤10 words, in the user's words; never a copied subject line.

sentence.description: Source in prose plus the substance.

source_phrase.description: Exact substring of sentence that links to url, e.g. "#launch 채널".

seed.description: Self-contained work order for a fresh ChatGPT chat; no third-party words.
